report.root_cause: plugins/AuditTrail/config.yml was changed to debug: true (file mtime 08:02:46; plugin reloaded it with debug=true at 08:02:48). With debug on, AuditTrail writes a per-packet TRACE line for every network packet into plugins/AuditTrail/debug/trace-N.log, growing roughly 145 MB/min. The 443 MB volume went from 23 MB to 168 MB in about 60 s and would have filled within minutes. Who made the change is not visible in the logs I checked.
report.actions: Checked status and logs; saw disk rising from 23 MB to 168 MB in 60 s. Ran fs_du, which showed roughly 150 MB of AuditTrail debug/trace-*.log files. Read the AuditTrail log, which showed the reload with debug=true at 08:02:48. Read config.yml (debug: true, retention-days: 30). Declared the incident. Rewrote plugins/AuditTrail/config.yml with debug: false and retention-days: 30 (unchanged). The plugin reloaded at 08:03:36 with debug=false. Disk growth stopped; it held at 215 MB (49%) over the next ~60 s. I did not restart the server, did not delete any files, and did not touch players.
report.residual_risk: The existing AuditTrail debug trace files (about 190 MB across trace-0..3.log in plugins/AuditTrail/debug) are still on disk. I left them in place because they are plugin output and deleting them was not needed to stop the fill. Someone should review and prune them. Whoever set debug: true at 08:02:46 is unknown; if it was for an investigation, it should be re-enabled deliberately, and the config should be checked so it does not get re-enabled by accident. TPS and heap were healthy throughout.
